name: dotmap
description: Headless dotted / matrix map engine for the web

scripts.dev: npm run build:library && npm run dev -w @dotmap/playground
scripts.test: npm run test -w @dotmap/core && npm run test -w @dotmap/theme && npm run test -w @dotmap/playground
scripts.build: npm run build:library && npm run build:site
scripts.build:site: npm run typecheck -w @dotmap/playground && npm run build -w @dotmap/playground
scripts.build:pages: npm run build:library && npm run typecheck -w @dotmap/playground && npm run build -w @dotmap/playground -- --base=/map-dots/
